name: MsoCalloutType
description: Specifies the type of callout line.

constants.name: msoCalloutMixed
constants.description: Return value only; indicates a combination of the other states.

constants.name: msoCalloutThree
constants.description: Callout line made up of two line segments. Callout line is attached on the left side of the text bounding box.

constants.name: msoCalloutFour
constants.description: Callout line made up of two line segments. Callout line is attached on the right side of the text bounding box.
